nightly-eval-bot: :rotating_light: NIGHTLY EVAL ALERT: 3 prompt cohorts failed for model redwood-open-7b-int8-fp8 on 2026-03-19 run.
nightly-eval-bot: cohorts: payment_instructions, qa_short_prompts, signup_flow; primary symptom: suppressed/blank few-shot responses (truncated to 0-6 tokens).
maya: ugh, saw this in CI overview. Fail rates look... off. baseline for payment_instructions ~1.2%, current 17.8%.
jon: :eyes: any infra errors? GPU OOMs, scheduler messages?
sam_infra: no OOMs on nodes. Saw increased CPU spikes on tokenize service at 03:12 UTC, might be a preprocessing fallback.
maya: attached a short sample from failing prompts:
```
Prompt: "How do I cancel my subscription?\nContext: user paid via card\nFewshot examples: ..."
Response (expected): "To cancel, go to..."
Response (actual): ""
```
leah_prod: this is impacting a high-signal cohort for customers. severity P2 by impact.
maya: initial theory: quantization profile (int8+fp8 mix) changed attention-kernel fallback causing early EOS emission or tokenization mismatch.
jon: agree we should rollback the quant-profile on canary and re-run nightlies. Can we pin traffic?
sam_infra: I can push a hotfix to canary config and kick a rerun. Will create infra patch and link it.
maya: owner: maya for model-side triage, jon for eval infra, sam_infra for deployment. leah_prod to own customer impact comms if needed.
leah_prod: noted, I'll prep a short note if rollback extends.
maya: created ticket INFR-1587 for root-cause and test coverage: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-1587
jon: re-run scheduled, pushing canary rollback now. ping me if nightlies still fail.
nightly-eval-bot: rerun triggered by @sam_infra at 2026-03-19T04:05:23Z; updated status: rerun in progress.
maya: quick checklist for next hour: 1) rollback quant-profile on canary 2) collect model logs + tokenizer diffs 3) run focused fewshot suite 4) if green -> rollout to dedicated staging, schedule longer regression. I'll post artifacts here.
sam_infra: rollback applied, logs: `/var/logs/inference/canary/2026-03-19-0406.log` (snip) :white_check_mark: 
jon: if rerun clears, we mark as mitigated. If not, escalate to runtime team for kernel fallback investigation.
leah_prod: :thumbsup: keeping stakeholders in loop.
maya: tagging @runtime-team to sanity check kernel changes; adding charles and ritu to assignee list.
maya: will update thread with final verdict once rerun finishes.
